lines.en: WHAT A SHAME THAT IT MUST BE PURGED.
It’s tomorrow now.
Well, I guess it’s never really tomorrow.
But it’s a day different from the last.
I’m waking up in a different bed.
I’m feeling sunlight bleed in through different windows.
There are different shadows on the floor. Different background noises and different foreground scenery.
But I’m no different than I was just twelve hours ago.
Even if I made another terrible mistake — carved another terrible gash into one of my terrible limbs that I can gaze at on the long walk home while thinking something vague like “why?” or “how?”
But what’s even more terrible than that metaphorical gash is that I already have an answer to both of those questions.
I have told you I am weak.
I have told you I am scared.
And I’m sure you’re far too tired by now to hear me repeat those same self-loathing belittlements time and time again.
This happened because there is a gap in my heart.

There’s a space that someone left a long time ago that only one person has been able to fill, and I’ve become so desperate that I can’t help but shove anything half-resembling her shape inside me now that she’s gone.
Yesterday, I found someone who looks a lot like her.
Her voice is the same.
Her scent is the same.
The way I tower over her yet feel so much smaller is the same.
But of course, she’s not a perfect fit.
If she was-
She wouldn’t look like this.
If she was, I’d have no need to block her out again — and the two of us could ride off into the sunset as the worst, most-unsuited lovers you could ever imagine.
But instead we’re here.
It’s not tomorrow.
It’s never really tomorrow.
But that just means I have a brand new chance to forgo romantic complacency and drown forever inside of the abyss that is never understanding how to make something fit when it’s not supposed to.
Because I know other people do.
I know other people settle.
But I know the feeling of finding something perfect. And I know the feeling of losing it even more.
And that’s why I can not stand for less.
That’s why I’ll aim for tomorrow again.
One night was all I needed.
And this doesn’t mean I’ll let her go.
I don’t know if I ever can.
But I didn’t have a dream last night.
And I’m not sure if that’s good or bad.
You get dressed and leave the house again.
You make another mistake.
Why can’t you just stay still?
: Mmmm!
: Hah...
Something stirs.
She scans the room for the man she fell asleep beside, but all she finds are different shadows and a different foreground.
: That fucking asshole just left me here on my own, didn’t he?
She gets herself out of the unfamiliar bed.
It wasn’t the first time something like this had happened.
He used to let her sleep after long nights as she had trouble getting up in the morning after them.
But this time was different.
This time, she thought that maybe he’d have slept in with her.
This place, unfamiliar as it may be, could have been their castle.
It didn’t have to stay unfamiliar for long. But now she feared that it would- and that she’d have to search for him all over.
For how long would she be willing to do that?
You know the answer, of course.
But she doesn’t.
So it’s like everything is brand new.
Everything is scary again.
She dresses herself in the same clothes she wore yesterday as the house she stayed in had never welcomed her before.
There was no trace of her anywhere. But now, there would be.
Now, her scent would be on his sheets. Her hair would be on his pillows. And he’d have to think of her.
It was precisely what she wanted.
However-
: ...Maya?
She was not the only one who wanted something like this.
: Uhhhhh...
: What are you doing all the way over here?
: What...are you doing all the way over here?
: I asked you first.
: I...am just...going for a morning walk. That’s all.
: Then why are you wearing your uniform?
: Well, you see...
: You don’t have a friend who lives over here, do you? Because I didn’t realize other people had started moving in yet.
: You...live here?
: Yeah! With my little sister. And sometimes Yumi, but she’s been mostly staying at my old place since it’s closer to her job.
: Wait! You’re not thinking of moving in too, are you?!
: What? Me? But I’ve already got...the dorm and...you know...
: Hey, you don’t have to be all shy and stuff! I think it’d be totally great if you lived here. I’m not trying to gate-keep it or anything. The more, the merrier.
: Plus, if you were looking at apartments, it would totally explain why you left the Dorm Wars early yesterday and forced us into an 8 vs 10 match-up where we also lost a point due to your absence.
: Ah...yeah. That’s why I left. I had to look at this apartment. And I am...now finally finished looking at it roughly twenty-four hours later.
: It was a very thorough inspection.
: Well, whatever’s going on, I’m not gonna pry. I’m sure you’ve got your reasons.

: What are your plans for the rest of the day, though? Still intent on going for a walk? Cause, if that’s the case, why not come with me to work? I could use the company since my boyfriend’s busy today.
: Boyfriend?
: Some older guy. You don’t know him.
: Either way, I don’t really feel like going to the mall. So-
: Oh, I’m not at the mall anymore. I work at the maid cafe with Uta now. And Ami when she’s not busy being a psychopath.
: The maid cafe? So-
: So I can get you a discount on food, yeah.
: Ahem...I suppose the rest of my walk can wait, then.
: Woo! Chika and Maya, new best friends going on an adventure across town!
: Does being your “best” friend increase the discount I receive? Because I will settle for “standard” friends if it does not.
: I’ll have to ask Uta.
: I’m pretty sure she’s busy right now, though.
: Attention, everyone!

: Thank you for coming all the way back here for this year’s Dorm Wars closing ceremony. And thank you even more for putting up with my rapid descent into madness as I crumble beneath the weight of the world!
: It was only a matter of time. Pretty soon, you’ll be dressing like me and verbally expressing your wish to be fully crushed by said weight.
: And thank you all for doing more for my mental health than Wakana has lately!
: You should bang the taco man.
: Rika as well.
: Why are you wearing that?
: I went for a morning jog along the track. I do that every day.
: You do that...willingly?
: Yeah. It’s a surprisingly good way to pick up girls and Rin deserves a third mom.
: I guess that explains why Nodoka is in her gym clothes as well.
: No matter how many times I apply for the job as Rin’s third mother, I’ve yet to receive so much as a call back.
: Rika, as a friend, I’d like to advise you that attempting to pick up women at your workplace is bad enough, but it takes on a new level of bad when your workplace is also a high school.
: You’re probably right. And that also explains why that girl who hits on you all the time keeps hitting on me as well.
: I think they’re talking about you, Nodoka.
: Leave me be, Otoha. I do not fail very often. But when I do, it hurts just the same as it does for anyone else.
: Does it really?
: I didn’t realize you had feelings as you’ve yet to actually apologize for all of those things you wrote about me in your book.
: Would you have Picasso apologize for turning so many people into cubes? Or Tarantino for turning so many screenplays into unwatchable trash?
: No. But if either of those artists decided to air out their best friend’s sex life to thousands of people, I would. Right, Otoha?
: Hey, don’t get me wrapped up in this. I’ve done a damn good job of remaining neutral at basically everything so far.
: Are you still that upset with me over the book? I haven’t touched it in months.
: No, I’m fine. Just saying.
: Huh...
: Soooo...
: So, what are we allowed to discuss and what are we not allowed to discuss about what happened last night? Because I need hard limits or I’m going to wind up telling everyone.
: I’ve already deleted the save file. As far as I’m concerned, nothing ever happened last night and no one ever watched me pleasure myself with a rubber tentacle. Game over.
: And...I definitely...never said anything that...you know...
: Sana, I think that if anyone permanently changed their image last night, it was you.
: Yeah, I’m not sure if I can unhear that fantasy of yours. That was hot as fuck.
: Rape fantasies are one thing. But taking the entirety of a fourteen inch dildo inside of you without a struggle? That’s a feat to remember.
: Yeah. You’re kind of a freak, Makoto.
: That was...actually...kind of cool...
: I definitely like you more now. That’s for sure.
: And to think that all this time, all I needed to do to gain the affection of others was to visibly penetrate myself with a sex toy.
: Hey, all I’m saying is it’s a lot easier to be a Makoto fan when you’re stuffing yourself with a fake dick than it is when you’re throwing worksheets at us.
: You know what’s even hotter than rape fantasies, though? The fact that we’re all better friends now.
: What?
: Between this and the pony thing, I think most of us are starting to believe you just have some very...unusual fetishes, Noriko.
: Oh, come on! I didn’t mean it’s like, actually arousing.
: I’m just glad we all made some really intense memories that we can’t ever talk to anyone outside of the group about since we signed a legally binding document.
: You say that as if you didn’t have the easiest job out of literally everyone.
: In my defense, Sana’s job was just as easy as mine. It is not my fault that she decided to take things a step further.
: I still think...you did a really great job...
: I just...think I did a little better...
: God! Since when are you such a little freak?!
: Heheh...just remember that...I was only there...because Rin made me go...
: New Sana scares me.
: The chains have been released...
: Only the gods can stop Zagull now.
: Considering that about a quarter of the class isn’t here right now, I’ll try to keep things short and sweet.
: The final score of the SMUS-DDW: NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB is 5 to 5.
: However, as previously stated in the Dorm Wars preamble, one point will be deducted from the floor hosting any girl apart from Ami that does not participate.
: Surprisingly enough, we only have one girl who fits that bill and it’s Maya Makinami. Who, fittingly, is not here now either.
: As such, the score becomes 5 to 4 in favor of the second floor, who can now call themselves the SMUS-DDW: NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB champions! Hooray and go team!
: But of course, unless your name is Makoto, winning was never really the goal of this year’s Dorm Wars. The true goal was learning to work as a team.
: But the true-er goal was just taking a load off of your backs and your minds for a little while.
: I remember what it’s like to be a teenager. I was one of them not all that long ago, you know. Like, I’m still mad young. And youthful! And relatable! Right?!
: Just get on with it, Imani.
: Point is, I know things have been tough lately. And I know that stress is probably getting to you now more than it ever has before. But life’s still meant to be enjoyed at the end of the day.
: So, whether you’re swimming through a pool of baby alligators...or playing a game with a giant ball that could crush any of you at any given moment...always try to look on the bright side.
: And, if you can’t — remember that you’ve got a whole class worth of girls who’d be happy to help you.
: Class dismissed!
: As thrilled as I am to be on the winning side of this year’s contest despite two personal losses, I can’t help but wonder why Maya elected to not participate.
: Maya...is going through some shit right now. So, if it seems like she’s been acting weird lately, that’s probably the cause.
: Strange. She’s seemed mostly normal to me apart from her disappearance yesterday. But I suppose I don’t know her nearly half as well as you do.
: How’s Yasu, by the way? Is she feeling any better?
: Oh, yes. In fact, she was back to her normal self just this morning — pacing up and down the hall, screaming about “horrible changes that have yet to take root” or something along those lines.
: Oh, is that what that noise was? I kind of figured Molly was just playing some kind of game again.
: Not quite. Molly didn’t return home until rather late. I wound up having to wake her up just so she wouldn’t miss the closing ceremony.
: Tsuneyo was nowhere to be found, though. But I assume she’s likely just at work.
: And how’s Io doing, Uta?
: ...How’s Io doing, Uta?
: Huh? What?
: Have you no shame?
: None at all. I lost that a loooooong time ago. Sorry, Touka.
: Io. How is she? Is she still...upset about Nodoka’s comment?
: Did something happen between the two of them while I was with Yasu in the infirmary?
: Yeah, but...I think it’s best if as few people as possible know what was actually said.
: Io’s pissed. But she has stuff she can take to, like...turn her brain off when she has to. Me on the other hand? I’m fucking livid.
: Oh my. It must have been terrible if it’s gotten you to speak in such a manner. You’re typically so kind and polite. When you’re not undressing me with your eyes, of course.
: I don’t care how much Nodoka thinks she knows. Io was right when she said she’ll never get it. She doesn’t have the faintest fucking clue what that girl has gone through.
: I can’t even look at her right now. And I want to forget it even happened, but...I’m not sure if I can.
: Listen — I know Io’s not perfect. She’s not even close.
: She’s toxic and mean and just...genuinely unlikable. But she’s only like that because of everything she’s had to deal with to get here.
: So I’m sorry if it ever seems like she’s doing all of that just to distance herself. Which...she is. But it’s for her own safety and-
: You don’t have to apologize, Uta. It doesn’t matter what we think of Io. I’m sure we’re all in agreement that Nodoka’s comment crossed a line that no one thought was okay.
: I just wanted to know if she was doing okay. That’s all. And, if she’s not, if there’s anything I can do to help.
: I’m still mostly in the dark here, but I’d like to lend my assistance as well if such a thing is warranted.
: It’s fine, guys. She’ll be okay. I just...
: I hate that this happened.
: We’ve all got secrets that could kill us if they get out.
: Like, there are parts of me that I’m afraid of you all knowing as well...
: But to have them revealed by someone who doesn’t even understand the context? Who can just...casually blurt them out like they’re things that just happen?
: That makes me want to puke.
: I try to stay happy. I try to stay optimistic. I try to do so many things and, half of the time, I don’t even know who I’m doing them for.

: But I do them because that’s all I can do. That’s all we can do. Just...try. Just try, try, try and fucking fail and lose and cry because no matter how positive we try to be, bad things are still going to happen.
: And that terrible past will never go away no matter how much we wish it would.
: I just want her to be happy.
: I want all of us to be happy.
: But sometimes, that just feels like a dream.
: And sometimes, I wonder if I’ll ever really feel happy again.
I walk into my room to find more familiar sunlight bleeding in through a more familiar window.
What do I want to do with my day?
